subsections.title: Classification
subsections.content: This chemical is considered hazardous according to [US] OSHA (29 CFR 1910.1200, 2024)

subsections.title: Hazard Statements
subsections.content: Highly flammable liquid and vapor Causes serious eye irritation

subsections.title: Prevention
subsections.content: Wash face, hands and any exposed skin thoroughly after handling Wear eye/face protection Do not breathe dust/fume/gas/mist/vapors/spray Use only outdoors or in a well-ventilated area Keep away from heat, hot surfaces, sparks, open flames and other ignition sources. No smoking Keep container tightly closed Ground and bond container and receiving equipment Use explosion-proof electrical/ventilating/lighting equipment Keep cool Wear protective gloves/protective clothing/eye protection/face protection Take action to prevent static discharges Use non-sparking tools

subsections.title: Response
subsections.content: IF exposed or concerned: Get medical attention/advice

subsections.title: Inhalation
subsections.content: IF INHALED: Remove person to fresh air and keep comfortable for breathing

subsections.title: Skin
subsections.content: IF ON SKIN (or hair): Take off immediately all contaminated clothing. Rinse skin with water or shower

subsections.title: Eyes
subsections.content: IF IN EYES: Rinse cautiously with water for several minutes. Remove contact lenses, if present and easy to do. Continue rinsing If eye irritation persists: Get medical advice/attention

subsections.title: Fire
subsections.content: In case of fire: Use CO2, dry chemical, or foam to extinguish

subsections.title: Storage
subsections.content: Store locked up Store in a well-ventilated place. Keep container tightly closed

subsections.title: Disposal
subsections.content: Dispose of contents/container to an approved waste disposal plant

subsections.title: Hazards classified under paragraph (d)(1)(ii) of 1910.1200
subsections.content: No information available WARNING. Cancer and Reproductive Harm - https://www.p65warnings.ca.gov/.

subsections.title: Eye Contact
subsections.content: Rinse immediately with plenty of water, also under the eyelids, for at least 15 minutes. Get medical attention.

subsections.title: Skin Contact
subsections.content: Wash off immediately with plenty of water for at least 15 minutes. If skin irritation persists, call a physician.

subsections.title: Inhalation
subsections.content: Remove to fresh air. If not breathing, give artificial respiration. Get medical attention if symptoms occur.

subsections.title: Ingestion
subsections.content: Clean mouth with water and drink afterwards plenty of water.

subsections.title: Most important symptoms and effects
subsections.content: Difficulty in breathing. Inhalation of high vapor concentrations may cause symptoms like headache, dizziness, tiredness, nausea and vomiting

subsections.title: Suitable Extinguishing Media
subsections.content: Water spray, carbon dioxide (CO2), dry chemical, alcohol-resistant foam. Water mist may be used to cool closed containers.

subsections.title: Specific Hazards Arising from the Chemical
subsections.content: Flammable. Risk of ignition. Vapors may form explosive mixtures with air. Vapors may travel to source of ignition and flash back. Containers may explode when heated. Thermal decomposition can lead to release of irritating gases and vapors. Keep product and empty container away from heat and sources of ignition.

subsections.title: Protective Equipment and Precautions for Firefighters
subsections.content: As in any fire, wear self-contained breathing apparatus pressure-demand, MSHA/NIOSH (approved or equivalent) and full protective gear.

subsections.title: Personal Precautions
subsections.content: Use personal protective equipment as required. Ensure adequate ventilation. Remove all sources of ignition. Take precautionary measures against static discharges.

subsections.title: Environmental Precautions
subsections.content: Do not flush into surface water or sanitary sewer system.

subsections.title: Methods for Containment and Clean
subsections.content: Soak up with inert absorbent material. Keep in suitable, closed containers for disposal.

subsections.title: Up
subsections.content: Remove all sources of ignition. Use spark-proof tools and explosion-proof equipment.

subsections.title: Handling
subsections.content: Wear personal protective equipment/face protection. Ensure adequate ventilation. Avoid ingestion and inhalation. Do not get in eyes, on skin, or on clothing. Keep away from open flames, hot surfaces and sources of ignition. Use only non-sparking tools. To avoid ignition of vapors by static electricity discharge, all metal parts of the equipment must be grounded. Take precautionary measures against static discharges. Storage. Keep containers tightly closed in a dry, cool and well-ventilated place. Keep away from heat, sparks and flame. Flammables area. Incompatible Materials. Strong oxidizing agents. Strong acids. Acid anhydrides. Acid chlorides.

subsections.title: Engineering Measures
subsections.content: Ensure adequate ventilation, especially in confined areas. Use explosion-proof electrical/ventilating/lighting equipment. Ensure that eyewash stations and safety showers are close to the workstation location.

subsections.title: Eye/face Protection
subsections.content: Wear appropriate protective eyeglasses or chemical safety goggles as described by OSHA's eye and face protection regulations in 29 CFR 1910.133 or European Standard EN166.

subsections.title: Skin and body protection
subsections.content: Wear appropriate protective gloves and clothing to prevent skin exposure.

subsections.title: Respiratory Protection
subsections.content: Follow the OSHA respirator regulations found in 29 CFR 1910.134 or European Standard EN 149. Use a NIOSH/MSHA or European Standard EN 149 approved respirator if exposure limits are exceeded or if irritation or other symptoms are experienced.

subsections.title: Recommended Filter type
subsections.content: Organic gases and vapours filter. Type A. Brown. conforming to EN14387.

subsections.title: Hygiene Measures
subsections.content: When using do not eat, drink or smoke. Provide regular cleaning of equipment, work area and clothing.

subsections.title: Flammability (liquid)
subsections.content: Highly flammable On basis of test data

subsections.title: Explosive Properties
subsections.content: Vapors may form explosive mixtures with air

subsections.title: Reactive Hazard
subsections.content: None known, based on information available

subsections.title: Conditions to Avoid
subsections.content: Keep away from open flames, hot surfaces and sources of ignition. Incompatible products.

subsections.title: Incompatible Materials
subsections.content: Strong oxidizing agents, Strong acids, Acid anhydrides, Acid chlorides

subsections.title: Information on expected route of exposure
Inhalation
subsections.content: May cause irritation of respiratory tract. May be harmful if inhaled. INHALATION MAY CAUSE CENTRAL NERVOUS SYSTEM EFFECTS.

subsections.title: Ingestion
subsections.content: May be harmful if swallowed. Aspiration hazard if swallowed - can enter lungs and cause damage. Ingestion may cause gastrointestinal irritation, nausea, vomiting and diarrhea.

subsections.title: Skin
subsections.content: Irritating to skin. May be harmful in contact with skin.
